name: XDKNet 2.9.0
body:
Android TV 2.9.0. Update the server plugin to XDKNet 2.1.0.19 (Emby
2.0.5.19) as well: Incomplete recordings, the record prompt, PIN sync,
reminders, poster labels, Smart Search, the media bar's outside lists, the
Discover sliders and Watching on MDBList all need it, and stay hidden until
the server has it.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

The rest of Moonfin 2.7 to 3.1.

## Everything is laid out the way Moonfin lays it out

- Every TV now uses Moonfin's 1150-point layout. On most Android TV boxes
  (Google TV, Chromecast, Shield, Fire TV) that makes everything about 17%
  smaller, so more fits on screen. UI Scale still works on top of it, and
  Grandparents or Great-Grandparents make it bigger again.
- **Impeller**: boxes that run Flutter's newer renderer well (recent Android,
  64-bit, a suitable GPU, not Shield or Fire TV) switch to it at the next
  launch. Settings > Playback & SyncPlay > Advanced Options > Performance >
  Renderer can put a box back on Skia.

## Settings, as Moonfin draws it

- Pickers show a radio beside each choice, and a setting's value has more
  room beside its name.
- The live preview has Moonfin's strip of scenes: Home, Details Screen,
  Player, Search and Calendar, plus the screensaver. It never goes blank, and
  Right from a setting moves into the scenes.

## Details screen

- Three more styles, under Details Screen Style: **Spotlight**, **Nouveau**
  and **Minimalist**. Modern is still the default.
- Spotlight and Nouveau give a person their own page, bring in Seerr's
  recommendations and similar titles, and give a collection a Playlist Order
  to play from. Spotlight's File Details say whether the file plays as it is.

## Live TV and the Calendar (with plugin 2.1.0.19)

- A recording that stopped early is marked **Incomplete**, with how much was
  recorded, and anyone who manages Live TV can **Keep as Complete**.
- Recording a programme already on the air offers the next showing instead.
- A bell on the Calendar sends a reminder when that title reaches the
  library.
- OK on the remote opens a recording or series recording.
- A channel gets 30 seconds to show its picture before reconnecting.

## Sign-in and PIN

- **Add Server** is one button. It shows the address being checked, then
  the server it found.
- With plugin 2.1.0.19, a user's sign-in **PIN** is kept on the server and
  works on all their devices. A PIN set on this TV moves there the first time
  it is entered correctly. Only an administrator can reset it.
- **Client certificates**: a server that asks for one can be given it, also
  by sending it from a phone to the QR code the TV shows.
- The setup wizard asks for the default audio and subtitle languages, and
  offers administrators the XDKNet plugin when the server lacks it.

## Home

- Classic rows have bigger titles, the series name above an episode, and a
  one-line info strip. A Grandparents card size is new.
- **Media Preview** is now Off, Media Preview or Trailer Preview.
- With several servers, collections from any of them can be Home rows.
- IMDb, TMDB and custom list rows show your own copy's poster and progress,
  in the app's language, with descriptions.
- With plugin 2.1.0.19: the media bar can show titles from those lists, a
  **Watching on MDBList** row is available, and Seerr's Discover sliders can
  go on Home.
- The Banner media bar shows the title's whole banner.
- Continue Watching and Next Up catch up after coming back to Home during a
  reload, and come out in the right order on Emby.

## Search and Seerr

- Search is a centred pill with the mic inside it; Right reaches the mic.
- With plugin 2.1.0.19 and Smart Search turned on by the server's admin,
  sentences such as "90s movie about a kid pulled into a board game" get a
  **Smart Search** row, and with Seerr a row of the titles the library lacks.
- Seerr is called by the name the server's admin gave it, everywhere.
- Seerr and list cards show TMDB's titled artwork.

## Posters

- With plugin 2.1.0.19, the admin can put **4K, HDR and Atmos** labels on
  posters. Each user can turn them off under General Style.

## Settings sync and downloads

- Settings Sync shows the profiles as cards, and the one picked stays picked.
- Remove Watched Downloads can ask before deleting.

## Administration (off TV)

- Five groups, search for single settings, a Save / Discard bar, a live
  dashboard, library options when adding a library, and Emby's own server
  pages on Emby.
- Library > Smart Search turns the plugin's Smart Search on, picks its model
  and shows the model download and the library index, with Rebuild index.

## Books

- EPUBs open in real pages, with the place kept on Jellyfin.
- Comic and PDF progress is kept on the server, and the comic reader's bars
  hide on their own while Left and Right turn pages.

## Fixes

- The first Back on a page is no longer swallowed after a menu or the
  keyboard was closed with Back.
- A phone call or voice assistant no longer retunes the Live TV channel.
- Looking for DLNA devices no longer crashes the app.
- When only the audio has to be converted, the server can keep HEVC video as
  it is.
- The media bar's random slides come from the whole library.
- Every photo in a slideshow stays up its full five seconds.
- Emby: channel items from a plugin's virtual library play, and a remote
  server that turns down the reachability check is no longer called
  unreachable.
- Administrators can search for and download subtitles.
- Seerr's download progress leaves out releases Sonarr or Radarr hold back.
